title: Charter the Project Director seat: human-invoked owner of the contract-review chain, the adjudication duty and the maintainer-action ledger
body:
Fixes #12661

Charters the **Project Director (项目总监)** seat in the pm-dispatch protocol: a human-invoked seat (no Routine, no cron — parked carriers are the designed-safe state) owning three duties — the `needs:contract-review` review chain, the adjudication duty (决裁勤务), and (mid-flight maintainer ruling) the maintainer-action ledger (`pm:awaiting-maintainer` custodianship).

## Authorization (verbatim, untranslated, carried into the charter)

- 「项目总监 由人工定期指挥，负责处理 contract-review 类别的和需要决裁的。」 (maintainer, 2026-08-27 — the seat's charter source)
- 「项目总监 工作的基本原则，5张一批，要从业务角度解释清楚问题和和选项，并带上四维综合分析」 (mid-flight ruling 1 — the seat's basic working principles; recorded on the card)
- 「需要维护者处理的事情，也归项目总监。」 (mid-flight ruling 2 — the third duty; recorded on the card)
- 「刚才说的 needs:contract-review 类别，项目总监处理时，如果是收尾，应该帮忙处理完到合并。如果有大的错误，应该改标签。如果是卡在决策卡，和我讨论该怎么处理。」 (mid-flight ruling 3 — the PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED tri-branch; relayed by the PM, card comment to be backfilled by the PM per its instruction)

## Files

1. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` (new, 75 lines)** — the charter: authorization quotes, human-invoked shape with the latency trade stated, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` gate (constant reference, no model name), triage-style bijection carve-out, the basic-principles section (batch of 5 · business-angle explanation of problem/options/costs · four-facet analysis per card — frame body NOT copied, referenced to its single source under `check:skill-frame-sync`), the three duties (contract-review chain with the PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED tri-branch, adjudication duty, maintainer-action ledger), and the supersession ledger.
2. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (1005/1005 held, net 0)** — `director` row added to the role-argument table; the 常设决裁流程 paragraph rewritten in place as the Director-seat paragraph (supersession of the 2026-08-26 adjudication-ownership half recorded with both quotes; skills-face work explicitly stays with the skills seat); auto-adjudication runner set rewritten 分诊 Routine 或 skills 席 → 分诊 Routine 或项目总监席; `pm:awaiting-maintainer` state-table row gains the Director ledger/exit ownership; two pointers retargeted (repo-classes provenance pointer, retired-summary-view tombstone pointer).
3. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (48/48 held, net 0)** — the ownership clause (2026-08-23 hourly self-bound cron, dead in fact) rewritten in place to the Director's human-invoked cadence, new provenance cited, cron not resurrected; stale hourly-era wording (子轮) updated.
4. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md` (44/44 held, net 0)** — awaiting exit clause rewritten: exit executor is now the Director seat (verify → clear label + evidence comment same stroke); the no-machine-exit-by-construction rule itself unchanged. *(Surface addition ordered by the PM's second dispatch increment.)*
5. **`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`** — director.md registered: CEILINGS row at the landed count 75 (headroom 0, shrink-only from landing), MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES pin 0, lane-enumeration self-test case extended to eight.
6. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` (35/35 held, net 0)** — *bounded in-place fix, same defect class:* the stale clause 「契约复审(条款②复审链)归分诊席,本席仅过渡期代行」 (superseded once already by the 2026-08-23 cron ruling, doubly stale after this card) rewritten to point at the Director charter and to state the skills seat's retained face — this is the 分界写清 half of the ruling.
7. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` (274/274 held, net 0)** — *bounded in-place fix, same defect class:* the one remaining hourly-clock ownership mention (契约复审的常设承担已收敛为 skills 席自绑小时钟) rewritten to the Director's human-invoked ownership; leaving it would contradict the rewritten clause in contract-review.md.

Items 6 and 7 are declared surface additions under the bounded in-place fix exemption: same defect class (stale review-chain-ownership clauses the named supersessions target), mechanical (correct shape pinned by the ruling quoted on the card), no other claim holds these files (PM walked open PRs at dispatch; the only lane in-flight is an engine-lane branch), same gate family (both files already under `check:pm-skill-ratchet` + id-lint; no new verification surface).

## Cut ledger (every SKILL.md add funded by same-file cuts; each cut's surviving home named)

| Cut | Surviving home |

| SKILL.md batch mechanics (≤5 per batch, one-line reply, four-piece atomic execution, roll-over, inbox-to-zero) | `references/lanes/director.md` duties 1–2 + `references/decision-analysis.md` (batch order, unchanged) |
| SKILL.md 2026-08-26 flow ruling quote 「决裁流程今天这样很好…应该写入技能。」 | `references/lanes/director.md` 基本原则 (re-anchored per mid-flight ruling 1) |
| SKILL.md 2026-08-19 retired-summary-issue quote + prohibition | `references/lanes/director.md` duty 2 (tombstone pointer in SKILL.md retargeted there) |
| SKILL.md invocation phrase (维护者说「处理决策卡」即入口) | `references/lanes/director.md` 授权与形态 (invocations per the card: 「处理决裁」/「处理 contract-review」/ explicit entry) |
| SKILL.md clause-② tail parenthetical (双载体同笔挂/清、载体不迁移) | already verbatim in `references/contract-review.md` 载体纪律 (was a duplicate) |
| contract-review.md 2026-08-23 quote 「要不还是你挂个定时处理审核吧」 + hourly-batching sentence | `references/lanes/director.md` supersession ledger (batching now from 基本原则) |
| contract-review.md parenthetical duplicate of the label-discipline hard-steps rule | already verbatim in its own 载体纪律 section |
| state-machine.md cross-ref parenthetical (互斥归上面的 ONE-OF 行) | the ONE-OF invariant itself is stated in the same file's 通则 (pointer, not a rule) |
